haikus.haiku:
Mist lifts green trees soft
Owls call as sun drifts down soft
Leaves whisper, birds sing
Happy #NationalWildlifeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Nutty breeze rolls soft
Shell cracks, cream spills bright in gold
Taste of sun in palm
Happy #NationalMacadamiaNutDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft snowflakes whisper
Candles glow like stars in night
Warm wishes melt hearts
#HappyBirthdayRichardWright from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft glow on night sky
Crickets hum, moon whispers low
Stars lean close to watch
Happy #LastQuarterMoon from @ClamBakeSanta
